verdict.rationale: Remote is a hosted global payroll, EOR, and contractor platform, so asking about self-hosting is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable or on-prem deployment of the core product. The cloneable sample apps, SDKs, CLI, and MCP server are integration building blocks against Remote's hosted API, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
